text: I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he's 7 months and I'm really scared, his temperature is 39.9. I think that's very high for a baby? His eye has gone pink and sticky too. He was sick once after his tea but he's kept his milk down since then, I think he's had most of his bottle. I don't know if I'm overreacting, his mum and dad are out and I can't get hold of them. Please tell me what to do
